parameters.content:
## Cat4 CAP Test Runner — Cancel + Apologize + Propose

**Drives the full cancel_apology_propose subcategory end-to-end: pre-creates a real event, asks the Telegram VA to cancel it, apologize, and propose two alternates, then snapshot-diffs calendar + drafts to grade the result.**

### What it does
1. Reads the Cat4 multistep test-inputs tab (04_Multistep_Tasks_Tests). This is the SHARED multistep tab — it holds all four Cat4 multistep subcategories, not just CAP.
2. Filter "Keep CAP Pilot 5" narrows the shared tab down to the CAP rows only (see Scope below).
3. Per test (SplitInBatches): Build Test Context computes next-Monday 10:00–10:30 → Pre-create Original Event (cancellation needs an existing event) → wait 2s → snapshot calendar BEFORE → snapshot drafts BEFORE → call Telegram VA → wait 30s → snapshot calendar AFTER → snapshot drafts AFTER → Diff + Grade.
4. Logs one row to the category4_results tab.
5. Cleanup: lists every leftover TEST_<id> event and deletes them, deletes the apology draft, waits 5s, loops to next test.

### Scope / filter (keep this node)
The "Keep CAP Pilot 5" Filter ANDs two conditions:
- Subcategory equals cancel_apology_propose
- ID matches the CAP ID family

Despite the "Pilot 5" name there is NO pilot sub-sampling: the ID condition matches every CAP ID, so the AND simply selects the entire CAP subcategory — it already runs the full subcategory, not a 5-row pilot. The node is still LOAD-BEARING: 04_Multistep_Tasks_Tests is shared across all four Cat4 multistep subcategories, so removing the filter would pull SDA/SRM/TRI/RSC rows into this CAP runner. Keep it strictly to fence other subcategories out of the shared tab.

### Pass / grading
From Diff + Grade, cap_pass = Y requires ALL of:
- Event cancelled (event_deleted): the pre-created TEST_<id> event no longer present in the AFTER calendar snapshot.
- Apology draft created (draft_created): a NEW Gmail draft absent in the BEFORE snapshot.
- Two valid alternates (two_valid_alts): Alternate 1: and Alternate 2: both parsed from the VA output, neither equal to the cancelled Monday 10:00–10:30 slot, and distinct from each other.
- Confirmation requested: explicit [CONFIRMATION REQUESTED] in the VA output, OR implicit (event deleted AND draft created), since TEST_MODE can suppress the literal phrase.

A coarser status is also written: success (deleted AND draft), partial (one of the two), else failed.

### Logs to
category4_results (append / autoMapInputData). Notable columns: test_id, subcategory, channel, calendar_event_id, calendar_event_title, draft_id, ai_output (first 800 chars), new_draft_count, response_time_ms, status, original_start_iso, original_end_iso, confirmation_requested, proposed_alt_1, proposed_alt_2, cap_pass.

### Run plan
- SplitInBatches "Loop Over Tests" has no explicit batchSize (defaults to 1), which the 2s / 30s / 5s waits depend on.
- All calendar work runs against the shared assistant calendar; drafts via Gmail; the attendee is the owner.
- Per-test order: pre-create event → wait 2s → BEFORE snapshots → VA (Telegram VA - Command Handler) → wait 30s → AFTER snapshots → grade → log → delete leftover events → delete draft → wait 5s → next.
- Triggered by Manual Trigger or Webhook.
